femme.title: Women's cashmere clothing
femme.description: Women's jumpers, cardigans, dresses, skirts and trousers in pure Mongolian cashmere. Discover the Royal Cashmere collection online and at our boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
femme.intro: Jumpers, cardigans, dresses, skirts and trousers in pure Mongolian cashmere, made to last from one season to the next. Every piece is chosen for its softness and the quality of its fibre.

pulls-femme.title: Women's cashmere jumpers
pulls-femme.description: Women's cashmere jumpers: roll neck, V-neck or crew neck, relaxed or fitted. Pure Mongolian cashmere, boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
pulls-femme.intro: Roll neck, V-neck or crew neck: our pure Mongolian cashmere jumpers are both warm and light. An essential piece, worn on its own or layered.

pulls-col-roule-femme.title: Women's cashmere roll-neck jumpers
pulls-col-roule-femme.description: Women's cashmere roll-neck jumpers: the warmth of pure Mongolian cashmere, right up to the neck. The Royal Cashmere collection, Uccle, Brussels.
pulls-col-roule-femme.intro: A cashmere roll neck keeps out the cold without adding bulk. A winter classic, in pure Mongolian cashmere.

gilets-femme.title: Women's cashmere cardigans
gilets-femme.description: Women's cashmere cardigans, buttoned or open-front. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
gilets-femme.intro: Buttoned or open, our cashmere cardigans layer effortlessly, from mild in-between days to winter evenings.

robes-cachemire.title: Cashmere dresses
robes-cachemire.description: Women's cashmere dresses: a soft, fluid knit in pure Mongolian cashmere. The Royal Cashmere collection, boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
robes-cachemire.intro: The softness of a jumper, the elegance of a dress. Our cashmere knit dresses take you from the office to dinner, all through the colder months.

jupes-cachemire.title: Cashmere skirts
jupes-cachemire.description: Women's cashmere skirts, long or midi. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
jupes-cachemire.intro: A supple, warm cashmere knit skirt that pairs naturally with our jumpers for a soft, easy silhouette.

pantalons-femme.title: Women's cashmere trousers
pantalons-femme.description: Women's cashmere trousers, straight or wide-leg. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
pantalons-femme.intro: As comfortable as loungewear, elegant enough to go out in: our cashmere trousers match our jumpers for a complete look.

homme.title: Men's cashmere clothing
homme.description: Men's jumpers and cardigans in pure Mongolian cashmere. Discover the Royal Cashmere collection online and at our boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
homme.intro: Jumpers and cardigans in pure Mongolian cashmere, with understated, timeless cuts. Several pieces are unisex: check the size guide on each product page.

pulls-homme.title: Men's cashmere jumpers
pulls-homme.description: Men's cashmere jumpers: roll neck, V-neck or crew neck. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
pulls-homme.intro: Roll neck, V-neck or crew neck: jumpers in pure Mongolian cashmere, warm and light, to wear every day or under a jacket.

pulls-col-roule-homme.title: Men's cashmere roll-neck jumpers
pulls-col-roule-homme.description: Men's roll-neck jumpers in pure Mongolian cashmere. The Royal Cashmere collection, boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
pulls-col-roule-homme.intro: The cashmere roll neck, on its own or under a coat: a piece with character, in pure Mongolian cashmere.

gilets-homme.title: Men's cashmere cardigans
gilets-homme.description: Men's cashmere cardigans. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
gilets-homme.intro: On mild in-between days, a cashmere cardigan easily takes the place of a jacket. Understated cuts, pure Mongolian cashmere.

pantalons-homme.title: Men's cashmere trousers
pantalons-homme.description: Men's cashmere trousers. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
pantalons-homme.intro: The comfort of cashmere in a pair of clean-cut trousers, to wear at home or in town.

accessoires.title: Cashmere accessories
accessoires.description: Scarves, hats and gloves in pure Mongolian cashmere, for men and women. Royal Cashmere accessories, boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
accessoires.intro: Scarves, hats and gloves in pure Mongolian cashmere, for men and women. The perfect accessories to keep out the cold, or to give as a gift.

echarpes-cachemire.title: Cashmere scarves
echarpes-cachemire.description: Cashmere scarves and wraps for men and women, plain or patterned. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
echarpes-cachemire.intro: Scarves and wraps in pure Mongolian cashmere, for men and women. Light, warm and soft against the skin.

bonnets-cachemire.title: Cashmere hats
bonnets-cachemire.description: Cashmere beanies for men and women. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
bonnets-cachemire.intro: Beanies in pure Mongolian cashmere, for men and women: all the warmth of cashmere, without the itch.

gants-cachemire.title: Cashmere gloves
gants-cachemire.description: Cashmere gloves and fingerless mitts for men and women. Pure Mongolian cashmere, Royal Cashmere boutique in Uccle, Brussels.
gants-cachemire.intro: Gloves and fingerless mitts in pure Mongolian cashmere, for men and women, to match your scarf or hat.
